annotate_panel_label — ANNOTATE paper op

• Data kinds: image2d → image2d

• Call: import annotate; annotate.annotate_panel_label(img, letter='a', corner='lt', margin=8, style='paren', font_size=16, color='neutral', box_alpha=0.72, text_color=None, box_color=None, scheme='okabe_ito', font_path=None) (or opsannotate.get("annotate_panel_label"))

Usage

Returns an image (image2d): a panel letter `(a)/(b)` placed in a corner.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`letter は 1 文字('a')か 0 始まりの番号(0 → a)。style` で

`(a) / a) / a / A` を選ぶ。

Raises

------

ValueError

未知の corner / style、文字が画像に収まらない。
